name: shuffle-large-library
title: Shuffle for Large Libraries
summary: Corrects the shuffle for libraries with more than 32767 songs.
description: The shuffle of the iPod keeps the count of songs in a 16-bit value. With more than 32767 songs, the value becomes negative. Then the shuffle writes outside the list, and the order is wrong. This patch gives the shuffle a 32-bit count.
details: Shuffle Songs and Shuffle Albums operate correctly with more than 32767 songs.
The patch also corrects a rare error: the shuffle can use the position after the end of the list.
With 32767 songs or fewer, the shuffle gives the same order as before.
notes: The patch changes 4 instructions in the firmware. It adds no code.
The deck shuffle of the card game does not change.

steps: Put more than 32767 songs on the iPod.
Flash a firmware with this patch.
On the iPod, select Shuffle Songs.
Make sure that Now Playing shows "1 of" and the full count of songs.
Push Next many times. Each song must play.
